config.name: Instance name

config.agentLater: Running on an agent comes in a later phase

result.empty: Not tested yet. "Save and test" runs one collection right away and shows the report.

proxies.sub: Global proxy list; plugins pick one from a dropdown, default is direct
proxies.loadFailed: Could not load the proxy list

list.title: Proxies
list.emptyHint: A plugin whose proxy field is empty connects directly; once you add a proxy you can pick it from the dropdown in plugin settings.

proxies.note: "Direct" is not a proxy entry: leave a plugin's proxy field empty to connect directly. Deleting a proxy that is in use pauses the instances using it and clears their proxy setting; choose a new proxy before resuming them.

legend.title: Available on
legend.meta: Decides which run locations can pick it
legend.hub: Only plugins running on the Raspberry Pi, e.g. a proxy that listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
legend.lan: The hub and agents on the LAN; agents on a public VPS cannot pick it.
legend.any: Every run location, including a VPS the hub dials out to.

drawer.name: Name
drawer.passwordHelp: Stored encrypted, never shown again. When changing the password, re-enter the username too.
drawer.remoteDnsLabel: Resolve domain names on the proxy server
drawer.remoteDnsHelp: socks5h always resolves remotely; socks5 is optional; http and https proxies resolve on the proxy side, nothing to set.
drawer.testHelp: Defaults to the Google 204 address and can be changed; the test uses the saved settings, not unsaved edits.

deleteDialog.title: Delete proxy "{{name}}"?
deleteDialog.bodyRefs: {{count}} instance(s) use it. These instances will be paused and their proxy setting cleared; choose a new proxy for them before resuming:
deleteDialog.bodyNone: No instance uses it, so it can be deleted right away.
deleteDialog.ack: I understand these instances will be paused
deleteDialog.inUse: An instance just started using this proxy; please review the affected instances.

fieldError.duplicate: A proxy with this name already exists

url.invalid: The target must start with http:// or https://

settings.sub: Global hub settings; changes take effect after saving

general.title: General
general.languageHelp: Global language for plugin text and notifications; use the 中/EN switch in the sidebar for this browser's UI language.
general.timezoneHelp: Schedules, logs and backup times all follow this time zone.
general.accessUrlHelp: Used for links in push messages; leave empty to omit links.

net.title: Network & security
net.httpsNow: This page is served over {{scheme}} · port {{port}}
net.httpsHelp: Direct HTTPS uses a self-signed certificate, so browsers will warn; an nginx reverse proxy is recommended for HTTPS. The hub must restart for a change to apply.
net.trustedHelp: Empty by default. X-Forwarded-* is only honored from these sources; the same headers from anywhere else are ignored.
net.httpsKiosk: The kiosk screen on this device needs HTTP; turning on HTTPS disconnects it. Use an nginx reverse proxy if you need HTTPS.

display.title: Display
display.reduceHelp: Turns off glow and motion; suits always-on screens or weak hardware. Same switch as on the Schedule page.
display.themeHelp: Light by default; affects the admin UI only, applies immediately and is remembered in this browser, no need to save. The screen theme is set under Schedule & themes.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.label: History
retention.help: Three downsampling tiers; data past its limit is purged by the hub periodically.

backup.title: Backups
backup.dailyHelp: Backup files are written to the backups directory inside the hub data directory.
backup.nasHelp: Encrypted sync to a NAS, coming in phase 2.

downloadWarn.title: Download backup
downloadWarn.body: The archive contains key files (encryption key, agent credentials, notification tokens). Keep it safe and never upload it anywhere public.

bar.hint: Applies on save; the HTTPS switch needs a hub restart

settings.savedRestart: Settings saved; the HTTPS change applies after the hub restarts

timezone.invalid: The server does not recognise this time zone; pick another

access_url.invalid: The access URL must be a valid address starting with http:// or https://

trusted_proxies.invalid: Not a valid IP or CIDR

daily_at.invalid: The backup time must be HH:MM

insp.titlePlaceholder: Leave empty for the default title

layoutEd.saved: Saved as v{{version}} and pushed to the display
layoutEd.saveInvalid: The layout failed validation ({{n}} problem(s)); check overlaps, bounds and sizes

undo.label: Undo
undo.title: Undo the latest change (⌘Z)
undo.conflict: Cannot undo: restoring it would overlap the current draft. The conflicting widgets are highlighted on the canvas; resolve them first.
undo.outOfBounds: Cannot undo: restoring it would fall outside the current grid. If the grid was shrunk, undo the grid change first.

chg.title: Unsaved changes
chg.meta: Based on v{{base}} · saving creates v{{next}} and pushes it to the display

discardDlg.title: Discard all unsaved changes?
discardDlg.body: The draft returns to v{{version}}; {{n}} change(s) will be lost.

leave.title: Leave the layout editor?
leave.body: You have unsaved layout changes; they will be lost if you leave.

conflict.title: The layout was updated by someone else
conflict.body: You edited from v{{base}}, but the server is now at v{{latest}}.
conflict.overwriteHint: Keeping mine overwrites their changes with your draft; their version stays in the history and can be rolled back to at any time.
conflict.overwrite: Keep mine and resubmit on the latest version
conflict.theirsNone: No differences to list against your base
conflict.again: The latest version changed again (v{{latest}}); review their changes again before resubmitting

history.title: Version history
history.brokenTitle: This version has widgets with broken references
history.confirmBody: This creates a new version v{{next}} with the content of v{{v}}; intermediate versions are not deleted.
history.confirmDirty: You have {{n}} unsaved change(s); they will be lost after the rollback.
history.confirmBroken: {{n}} widget(s) in this version have broken references and will show as placeholders after the rollback:

broken.instance_missing: The bound instance no longer exists
broken.instance_plugin_mismatch: The instance does not belong to the widget's plugin
broken.widget_missing: The plugin no longer provides this widget
broken.size_unsupported: The plugin no longer provides this size

outOfBounds.title: Shrinking to {{cols}}×{{rows}} puts {{n}} widget(s) out of bounds
outOfBounds.body: The widgets below do not fit the new grid; continuing removes them from the layout.

screens.sub: The index home page plus any number of screens, one grid per screen
screens.saveInvalid: The layout is invalid ({{n}} problems). Please check and try again
screens.dirtyHint: Based on v{{base}} · saving layout changes creates v{{next}} and pushes it to the display
screens.conflict: The layout was changed elsewhere: you are on v{{base}}, the latest is v{{latest}}. Reloading discards the unsaved changes on this page.

leave.title: Leave screen management?
leave.body: There are unsaved changes that will be lost.

chg.order: Changed the rotation order of the screens
chg.display: Screen display options (rotation, input mode, UI scale or daily restart)

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.homeOnlyDesc: Other screens can only be switched remotely.
rotation.autoDesc: Rotate the participating screens in the order listed below.
rotation.noTouchWarn: This display has no touch: with "Home page only", other screens can only be switched from Remote control, and there is no way to page by hand on the display.
rotation.idleHelp: After switching remotely to another screen, how long without interaction before returning to index.

grid.title: Grid
grid.label: Columns × rows
grid.help: Presets match 800×480 · 1024×600 · 1280×720; ★ is the one recommended for the display. When shrinking the grid, widgets that no longer fit are removed after you confirm.

list.title: Screens
list.meta: Drag the handle to change the rotation order · index stays on top
list.dragHint: Drag to reorder; Up and Down arrow keys on the handle also work
list.dwellInvalid: Dwell must be a whole number of seconds from {{min}} to {{max}}; leave empty for the default

delete.title: Delete screen {{id}}?
delete.body: Screen "{{name}}" and its {{n}} widgets will be removed from the layout once you save; the version history can still roll it back.

input.title: Display input
input.label: Input mode
input.detectedNone: The display has not reported touch capability yet.
input.help: Without touch the display shows no paging hint; rotation and remote switching are unaffected.

scale.title: UI scale
scale.label: Scale
scale.help: Enlarges text and spacing on high-resolution displays; the grid columns × rows stay the same.
scale.restart: After saving, the kiosk on this device restarts Chromium automatically and the scale takes effect.

screens.settingsFailedAfterLayout: The layout was saved (v{{version}}), but saving the settings failed: {{error}}

restart.title: Daily restart
restart.label: Restart browser daily
restart.help: Off by default. Only the kiosk Chromium browser restarts, not the hub or the Raspberry Pi; the time follows the timezone in settings.

remote.sub: Without touching the screen: refresh, switch, power
remote.offlineHint: The display is offline: refresh and switch screen are unavailable. Power on, power off and wake apply once the display reconnects.

reason.remote_on: Turned on remotely until {{until}} (the next period boundary), then back to the schedule.
reason.remote_off: Turned off remotely until {{until}} (the next period boundary), then back to the schedule.
reason.wake: Temporarily lit; back to the schedule when it ends at {{until}}.
reason.remote_on_open: Turned on remotely until the next period boundary, then back to the schedule.
reason.remote_off_open: Turned off remotely until the next period boundary, then back to the schedule.
reason.wake_open: Temporarily lit; back to the schedule when it ends.

keys.title: Keys
keys.meta: k1–k6 · sent to the kiosk right away

refresh.label: Refresh
refresh.desc: Reload the screen page; layout and data update immediately.

switch.label: Switch screen
switch.desc: Go to the target screen; back to the home screen after {{n}} s idle.

on.label: Power on
on.desc: Light the screen until the next schedule boundary, then follow the schedule again.

off.label: Power off
off.desc: Turn the display off until the next schedule boundary, then follow the schedule again.

wake.label: Temporary wake
wake.desc: Light the screen during an off period; it returns to the schedule when time is up.

token.label: Reset screen token
token.desc: The old token stops working at once; the kiosk on this device signs in again automatically, while screens on other devices must be reopened with the new token.

token.title: Reset the screen token?
token.warn: The old token stops working at once; the screen is disconnected and shows "Screen token invalid".
token.consequence: The kiosk on this device signs in again with the new token within seconds. Screens on other devices must be reopened with the new token link, and stay on their last frame until then.
token.doneBody: The new token was written to the screen.token file in the hub data directory. The kiosk on this device signs in again automatically; for screens on other devices, open this link to sign in again:
token.doneHint: Only needed on other devices: replace <token> with the contents of screen.token (a single line of text).

schedule.sub: The screen switches theme or turns off by period, in the global time zone

leave.title: Leave the schedule?
leave.body: The schedule or Reduce effects has unsaved changes that will be lost.

schedule.override: A remote action currently controls the screen; the schedule takes over again when it ends.

tl.title: 24-hour timeline
tl.meta: click a block to select · drag or use arrow keys to move boundaries · pick a theme below
tl.handle: Adjust the boundary at {{time}} (arrow keys ±5 min, Shift+arrow ±1 h)

list.title: Periods
list.deleted: Period deleted; the previous one now ends at {{time}}
list.addHint: A new period is cut out of the one it falls in, so the timeline always covers 24 hours.
list.tooShort: This period is too short to split

edit.title: Edit period {{n}}
edit.hintOff: Off periods have no theme; see 02.5 for wake rules
edit.linked: Changing a start or end time moves the neighbouring boundary too, so periods stay edge to edge.

problems.title: The schedule is invalid and must be fixed before saving
problems.theme: Theme is not a built-in theme or off
problems.empty: At least one period is required
problems.gap: {{from}}–{{to}} is not covered by any period

reduce.title: Reduce effects
reduce.help: Turns off glow and motion; good for always-on use or weak hardware. Same switch as Settings · Display.
reduce.settingsFailedAfterPlan: The schedule was saved but Reduce effects could not be saved: {{error}}

wake.title: Wake rules
wake.critSub: Lights for 10 minutes, then off again
wake.touchSub: Tap the screen to light it when touch is present
